integrity: Proof and standalone reproducibility checker included. Finite cases corroborate but cannot establish infinite-domain mathematics; no external independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Uniform conductance within each clique, one bridge, exactly two perfectly grounded leaders. The full five-candidate classification holds for all positive internal strengths and bridge weight; no wider topology or dynamic model is claimed. Historical priority is not established by a bounded literature search.
title: Sharp four-to-one boundary for concentration of two leaders in a weighted two-clique network
